description: This Java interface defines configuration settings for Server-Sent Events (SSE) within the Eclipse Ditto project, including a constant for the config path and a method to retrieve throttling configuration.

classes.name: SseConfig
classes.description: An interface providing configuration settings related to SSE, including a constant for the configuration path and a method to obtain throttling settings.
